hunt.accounts: self-registered via tempmail, always two (A and B)
hunt.rate: auto-derived from target behavior: start at pacing.delay_ms, back off on any 429/5xx, never push through
hunt.sprint_floor_rule: the configured sprint length is a floor: a session may run longer, never shorter. rh_clock wrap refuses while sprint time remains

machine.note: the incident this exists for: npx-spawned MCP servers do not die with the session; each new session spawns fresh instances and the old ones linger, stacking hundreds of MB each until the machine thrashes. rh_guard.py status/reap/budget enforces the limits; kickoff and wrap run it automatically

workspace.note_layout: bug-hunting scaffold pattern: the target workspace is created in the directory the tool is invoked from (./<slug>/), never in the home root. Journal and playbook live in the skill's own knowledge/ folder; machine state in the skill's state/ folder
